detail:
Keys (NEW at lane head lock-triage-r1r7):
R7|fnn-owner-maybe-reopen-log|swallow:error:fault,indet @ host/native/owner.lisp:8407 trail: protected form can signal ['fault', 'indet', 'os']

Hazard: owner.lisp:8403-8412 wraps open, fnn-log-swap-fd and fnn-owner-log in (handler-case ... (error (condition) (fnn-err ...))). Only an ambiguous close of the old descriptor is retained in the log debt ledger and re-raised at the next tick (owner.lisp:8392-8393); a fault from the malformed-line check in fnn-owner-log (owner.lisp:499-500) or any other core fault is logged as 'service log reopen failed' and consumed.
fix: Catch only the OS errors of the open (fnn-os-error) and let faults and indeterminate conditions escape to the maintenance actor's boundary, or classify the condition and route fault and indeterminate to fnn-owner-thread-escape.
notes: fnn-owner-maybe-reopen-log (owner.lisp) catches only fnn-os-error around fnn-owner-open-log; faults and indeterminate conditions from fnn-log-swap-fd / fnn-owner-log reach the maintenance actor boundary. Key R7|fnn-owner-maybe-reopen-log|swallow:error:fault,indet gone from --check on lane/lock-owner-class at a73f78a5e; none added. natives_owed: tests/test_native_*log*reopen / SIGHUP log-reopen native (grep SIGHUP tests/test_native_*.py).
title: fnn-owner-maybe-reopen-log: an error clause logs and continues for fault and indeterminate conditions of the reopen
